WESSELS, W. G. W.—B. 1878; ed. Kroonstad and Stellenbosch; organising inspr. of schls., O.F.S., 1912; inspr. of schls., 1914.

WEST, CAPT. J. H.—Ed. Middleton Coll. and Dublin Univ.; 2nd lieut., R.G.A. (S.R.), 1915; lieut., Aug., 1917; capt., Apr., 1918; France, 1917 to 1919; demob., May, 1919; French Croix de Guerre (with star); ast. dist. comanr., G. Coast, Sept., 1919.

WESTBROOK, MAJOR TOM, M.C.—Ed. Askes and Ratcliffe; served in S. African campaign, 1900-02; stock inspr., S. Africa, 1902-07; 2nd lieut., Hants T. Carabiniers, lieut., Hants Regt., major, Tank Corps; awarded M.C., 1917; ch. recruiting offr., W. Africa Chamber of Mines, Gold Coast, 1920-21; inspr., live stock, vety. dept., Gold Coast, 4th Jan., 1922.

WHEAR, JOHN FREDERICK.—B. 1867; ed. at public schools and at Prince of Wales Coll., P.E. Island; admitted as a barrister and attorney-at-law, 1890; served for four years as a city councillor in Charlottetown; elec. to the legis. assembly in 1900; as a mem. of the exec. coun. was associated with the late premier A. Peters and former lieut.-governor Rogers as delegates from the P.E.I. govt. for the settlement of provincial claims against the federal govt.; apptd. postmaster of Charlottetown, 1904; post office inspr., 1st Apr., 1911.

WHEATLEY, MAJOR H. H., O.B.E., M.C.—Served with Royal Engineers in France, 1914-19 (twice ment. in despa.); ast. to ch. engr. and sec. to govt., public wks. dept., Iraq, 1920; ast. adviser to min. of communications and wks., 1st Jan., 1921; adviser to min. of communications and wks., 9th Apr., 1922.

WHRBELL, CHARLES JOHN.—B. 1887; joined Royal North West Mounted Pol., Canada, Dec., 1912; proceeded overseas with 1st Canadian contingent, Sept., 1914; joined Irish Guards, Oct., 1914; transf. to 1st Guards Brig. Machine Gun Coy., Sept., 1915; served throughout Great War with Guards Divn., 1914-19; "1914-15" Star, Victory and Gen. Serv. Meds., Meritorious Serv. Med., Croix-de-Guerre (Belgian), ment. in desps., Apr., 1917; rejoined R.N.W. M. Pol., Canada, May, 1919; ast. comdt., pol., Bahamas, 21st Apr., 1921; ast. comdt., June, 1921 to Apr., 1923 and from May to Dec., 1924; comdt. of pol. inspr. of prisons, provost marshal and ch. of fire dept., 20th Aug., 1926.

WHEELER, LEONARD RICHMOND, B.A., B.Sc. (Lond.).—B. 1888; science master, Letchworth Schl., 1909-12; Gram. Schl., Antigua, 1912-14; entered col. serv. as science master, Queen's Royal Coll., Trinidad, Dec., 1914; coman. in 1st batt., B.W.I.R., from 1st Trinidad contingent, Sept., 1915; pilot, R.A.F., 1917; served in France and Salonica, 1916-19; returned to Trinidad, Jan., 1920; comanr. for Boy Scouts, Trinidad, 1920; transf. to S.S. and F.M.S. as European mast., Nov., 1921; science and maths. mast., Malay Coll., Kuala Kangsar, Dec., 1921; vice-prin., Sultan Idris Training Coll., Tanjong Malim, Aug., 1924; ast. inspr., schla., Peak, July, 1926; inspr., schla., Malacca, Sept., 1926; author of "Flora of Antigua," "Scouting in the Tropics," etc.

WHEELER, CAPT. RICHARD CHAMBERLAIN, M.B.E., M.R.C.V.S.—Veterinary offr., Kenya, July, 1913; senr. veterinary offr., Apr., 1920.

WHEELWRIGHT, CHARLES APTORPE, C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1873; mag.'s clk., Eshowe, Feb., 1890; clk. and interpr., Lower Umfolozi, Aug., 1892; office of res. comanr., and chf. mag., Mar., 1894; ag. ast. mag., Umlazi, Jan., 1896; ag. mag., Ingwavuma, Dec., 1897; mag., Mahlabatini, Apr., 1898; nat. comanr., Zoutpanberg, June, 1902; mag., July, 1907; Pieterburg, Aug., 1912; chf. nat. comanr., Natal, Mar., 1916.

WHISKARD, GEOFFREY GRANVILLE, C.B. (1923).—B. 1886; ed. St. Paul's Schl. and Wadham Coll., Oxford; 1st cls. mods., 1907; 1st cls. lit., hum., 1909; ent. H.O., 1911; ast. priv. sec. and subsequently priv. pvt. sec. to successive secs. of state, 1915-20; ast. sec., ch. sec.'s office, Dublin Castle, 1920-22; ast. sec., C.O., 1st Apr., 1924.

WHITCOMBE, SIDNEY F.—B. 1899; entered O.O., July, 1915; apptd., after compet. exam., ast. clk., C.O., 1917; on military service, Jan., 1918, to Apr., 1920; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

WHITE, ALEXANDER HAROLD, O.B.E., (1924).—B. 1889; ast. collr. (now ast. dist. comanr.), Zanzibar, 27th Dec., 1911; ag. 2nd ast. sec. and clk. of coun., 14th June, 1915; ag. 1st ast. sec., 7th Oct. to 28th Dec., 1915; ag. mag., His Highness' ct. for Zanzibar, 1918 (Brilliant Star, 4th cls., July, 1919); ag. dist. comanr., 21st Feb. to 20th July, 1919; ast. sec., German E. Africa, provisional admin., July, 1919; dist. political offr., Tanganyika Territory, 1st Apr., 1920; ag. mag., Dar-es-Salaam, Apr. to July, 1922; seconded for sp. serv. as Br. comanr., Anglo-Belgian bdy. comanr. (Ruanda-Urundi), Aug., 1922 to Aug., 1925.

WHITE, ARTHUR V.—B. 1871; ed. Woodstock Pub. and High Schs., and Univ. of Toronto (M.E.); engr. with several prominent firms; lect. in median. drawing and machine design, Toronto Tech. Schl.; later with dept. of pub. wks., Can.; consulting engrnr., Coman. of Conservation, Can., until its abolition, 1921; consulting engrnr., representing Can. to the internat. joint coman., Lake of the Woods investigation under the boundary waters treaty, 1911; consulting engrnr. to Hydro-electric Coman., Ontario, 1922; has written extensively on water power, elec. development and fuel supply.

WHITE, JAMES, F.R.G.S., Grad. R.M.C., Kingston, Canada.—B. 1863; entd. civ. serv., Canada, 1884; geographer and ch. draughtsman, geog. surv., 1894; ch. geographer, dep. of Interior, 1899; sec., Comanr.of Conservation, 1909, and sec. and ohmn. until its abolition, 1921; engaged on sp. work in connection with Labrador boundary dispute.

WHITE, WALLIS HARRY BRINSLEY.—Ed. at Bruton and Linc. Coll., Oxford; ast. master, St. Andrew's Coll., Grahamstown and Graaff Reinet Coll.; 1st class teacher's certif., Cape Colony; served during S. African War in Brabant Horse (Queen's medal and four clasps); inspr. of schla., O.R.C., 6th Jan., 1901; ch. ditto, 1st Feb., 1904; ag. dir. of educn., Aug., 1905, to Feb., 1906, and Apr. to July, 1907.

WHITE, W. ARTHUR.—Apptd. after open compet. exam. for home civil serv. to P.O., Jan.,
1890; 2nd div. olk., acctnt.-gen.'s dept., July, 1892; olk., controller's office, Mar., 1898; supt. of registrtn., G.P.O., Singapore, May, 1903; ag. supt. of mails, Oct., 1903; acctnt., postal dept., F.M.S., 1906; ag. dir., posts and telegraphs, F.M.S., 19th May, 1910 to 27th Aug., 1911, and 13th May, 1915 to 2nd Jan., 1916; sen. astt. auditor, external audit, S. Stiltns., and F.M.S., 1st July, 1917; seconded as collr. of war tax, Singapore, July to Nov., 1917; dir., external audit, S. Stiltns., and F.M.S., 12th May, 1919; ag. audr.-gen., S. Stiltns., in addition, 29th May, 1920 to 10th Nov., 1921; audr.-gen., 14th Aug., 1923.

WHITE, Rt. Hon. Sir William Thomas, P.C. (1920); K.C.M.G. (1916), B.A.—B. 1866; ed. High Schls., Oakville and Brampton, Ont., Univ. of Toronto (B.A.), graduate of the Ontario law schl.; app'td. manager National Trust Co., Ltd., Toronto, 1899; subsequently general manager and vice-pres. of the same institution; mem. of the Privy Council for Canada and min. of finance in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; ditto in National govt., Oct., 1917; re-elec. at g.e., Dec., 1917, for Leeds-Brockwood, resig. portfolio, July, 1919.

WHITE, W. V. C.—B. 1897; on mily. serv., 8th Sept., 1914 to 14th Dec., 1915; discharged through wounds, 17th Feb., 1916; ent. Miny. of Food, 18th Mar., 1918; appt. cler. offr., O.O., 24th Apr., 1922.

WHITEHEAD, Charles Basil.—Ast. supt. of pol., S. Stiltns., Sept., 1900; ag. second supt. of pol., Singapore, June to Sept., 1908, and from Sept., 1909, to Feb., 1910; astt. supt. of pol., Singapore, Feb., 1910, and again, Dec., 1910; ag. supt. of pol., Malacca, and ag. harbrm. in addition, June, 1910; ag. supt. of pol., Singapore, Dec., 1910; ag. supt. in charge, Prov. Wellesley, Oct., 1911; astt. supt. of pol., grade II, Jan., 1912; ag. supt. of pol., Penang, June, 1915; astt. supt. of pol., Prov. Wellesley, Sept., 1917.

WHITEHEAD, Frank Edred, O.B.E. (1926), M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.) certif. Lond. Schl. of Trop. Med.—B. 1880; ed. St. Bartholomew's Hosp., London; late hon. surg. County Hosp., Huntingdon; med. offr., Sierra Leone, May, 1913; Cameroons Exped. Force, Aug., 1914 to Feb., 1916; med. offr., Somaliland, June, 1916; senr. med. offr., Apr., 1919; senr. med. offr., Nyasaland, July, 1922; ag. prin. med. offr., Dec., 1922; dir., Med. and san'y. services.

WHITEHEAD, Louis Harold.—B. 1871; ch. olk. to atty.-gen., Trinidad, 1st Apr., 1906.

WHITEHORN, Roger Herbert, B.A. Cantab.—B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 17th Nov., 1911; attached to col. sec.'s office, 13th Dec., 1911; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Aug., 1912; ag. pol. mag., Gampola, Jan., 1913; office astt., Ratnapura Kach., Feb., 1914; pol. mag., Galle, May, 1914; 4th astt. col. sec., Sept., 1914; on military duty as astt. censor, Nov., 1914; ag. astt. govt. agt., Colombo, Apr., 1916; 4th astt. col. sec., Aug., 1916; ag. third astt. col. sec., Oct., 1918; priv. sec. to gov. in addition to his own duties, Nov., 1916; on military duty, 1918; extra astt. govt. agt., Colombo, Jan., 1920; ag. astt. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1920; ag. priv. sec. to offr. admstg. govt., 5th-23rd Apr., 1920; pol. mag., Kandy, Sept., 1922; ag. astt. govt. agt., Kegalla, Mar., 1923; astt. govt. agt., Colombo, Feb., 1924; ditto, Puttalam and Chilaw, Dec., 1924.

WHITEHOUSE, Bertram Reginald.—B. 1891; ed. at King Edward's, Birmingham, and St. John's Coll., Camb.; B.A. 1913; cadet, S. Stiltns. civ. ser., Feb., 1918, and lent to Johore; attached to censor's office, Singapore, till Apr., 1918; granted permission to join H.M. Forces, Apr., 1918; attached to land office, Johore, Sep., 1919; ag. supt. of Indian immigr., Nov., 1919; ag. collr. of land rev., Johore Bahru, June, 1920; offr., cls. IV., 9th Jan., 1922.

WHITEHOUSE, Lieut.-Commdr. G. T., D.S.C., R.N.R.—Pilot, Kenya, Feb., 1921.

WHITTING, John Beery.—B. 1869; entd. public serv., S. Australia, 1873; sec., state children's dept., 1886; sec. and regis. of stock in ag.-gen.'s dept., London, 1908; ag. agent-gen., 1914-15.

WHITLEY, Michael Henry.—B. 1872; ed. at Blundell's Schl. and King's Coll., London; jun. offr., Selangor, 1896; dep. pub. pros., F.M.S., 1906; legal adviser, Johore, 1910; called to the Bar, Inner Temple, 1913; ag. legal adviser, F.M.S., 1916; puisme judge, S.S. and jud. comm., F.M.S., 1918; ag. senr. puisme judge, S.S., 1921; ag. puisme judge, Penang, 1st Jan., 1922; ag. senr. puisme judge, Penang, June, 1922; atty.-gen., S.S., 1925.

WHITTALL, Lieut.-Col. Percival Frederick.—B. 1877; ed. Felsted; joined army, 1896; lieut., Lincolnshire Regt., 1902; served in S. African war, 1899-1900 (Queen's medal and three clasps); lieut., G. Coast Regt., 1907; rec'd thanks of S. of S. for services during outbreak of yellow fever at Secondee, 1910; astt. dist. commnr. N. Territories, G. Coast, 1912; released for service in European War, 1915-1919 (D.S.O. and one bar, French Croix de Guerre, 1914-15 Star); dist. commnr., N. Territories, G. Coast, 1918.

WHITTING, Charles Edward Jewel.—B. 1900; ed. Haileybury and St. John's Coll., Oxford; supt., eduon. dept., N. Provs., Nigeria, 26th July, 1922.

WHYBRO, Charles, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1902; ed. Berkhamsted Schl., London Univ., Schl. of Economics, and Christ's Coll., Cambridge, 1920-23; economic tripes, pt. I, 3rd cls., 1922; law tripes, pt. II, 3rd cls., 1923; supt., eduon., Tanganyika Territory, 1926.

WICKRAMASINGHA, Sena Pandukabhaya, B.A., LL.B. (Cantab.)—B. 1899; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1922; astt. to Matara kach., Dec., 1922; ditto, Batticaloa kach., Apr., 1923; extra office astt., Anuradhapura kach., Jan., 1925; office astt., ditto, June, 1925; pol. mag., Dandagamuwa, Feb., 1926.

WICKREMESINGHE, Cyril Leonard.—B. 1890; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. ser., Apr., 1912; attached to Badulla Kachcheri, Apr., 1912; Matara Kachcheri, Oct., 1912; office astt. to govt. agt., Uva, July, 1913; ag. pol. mag., Dandagamuwa, Nov., 1913; addl. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo and Avisawella, June, 1916; pol. mag., Kalutara, Mar., 1917; pol. mag., Jaffna, Mar., 1920; ag. addnl. pol. mag., Colombo, Negombo, and Avisawella, Mar., 1921; addnl. astt. govt. agt., Colombo, May, 1921; astt. govt. agt., Mannar, Mar., 1923; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, Nov., 1923; astt. govt. agt., Puttalam, Oct., 1926.

WICKWAR, Arthur Joseph.—B. 1871; ed. at St. Cuthbert's gram. schl., Newcastle-on-Tyne; astt. survr., Ceylon, 1st Sept., 1889; dist. survr., 13th Mar., 1897; supt. of topographical surveys, 23rd June, 1904; supt. of application surveys, 15th Oct., 1910; supt. of surveys, waste land ordce., 23rd Mar., 1913; astt.
survr.-gen., 1st Oct., 1914; deputy survr.-gen., 30th Nov., 1915; ag. survr.-gen., Jan.-Oct., 1920 and from Sept. to Dec., 1923; survr.-gen., Dec., 1923.

WIDDUP, CHARLES PONSONBY.—Clerical astt., treasy., B. Guiana, 1902; 6th cls. clk., lands and mines dept., 1903; ag. sub-inspr. of police, 1903; sub.-inspr. of police, 1904; qualified as musketry instr., Hythe, 1905; dist. inspr. of police, 1906; passed Hindustani exam., 1909; county inspr. of police, 1914; dep. inspr. gen., B. Guiana, 16th Dec., 1920.

WIGGINS, CLARE AVELING, C.M.G. (1923), M.R.C.S.(Eng.), L.R.C.P.(Lond.), Fellow, Entom. Soc.—Med. offr., E. Africa Prot., 4th Apr., 1901; med. offr., Uganda Prot., 4th Apr., 1908; dep. P.M.O., 1st Apr., 1911; ag. P.M.O., 18th May to 29th Nov., 1910, and 19th May to 26th Dec., 1913; D.A.D.M.S. (Mob.), 24th Oct., 1915, with rank of major; O.C. Uganda Native Med. Corps, and O.C. Uganda Bearer Corps, 17th Nov., 1915; ast. censor, 2nd Feb., 1916; off. censor, 12th Mar., 1916; P.M.O., Uganda.

WIGHTMAN, J. W. E.—Ast. dist. commr., Kenya, Apr., 1914; ag. res. commr., 1926.

WIGHTON, ALEXANDER RITCHIE, Mem., Transvaal Socy. of Acctnts.—Joined Impl. military rly., S. Africa, June, 1902; audit inspr., ch. acctnt.'s dept., 23rd June, 1903; acctnt., engrnr.'s dept., 1st Feb., 1904; ch. clk., ditto, 1st July, 1908; inspr., dept. of audr., S. African rly. and harb., 1st Apr., 1910; ch. inspr., ast. controller and audr.-gen.'s dept., Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; ch. inspr. (rly. and harb.), cont. and audit office, 1st July, 1916.

WIGHTWICK, CLAUDE.—B. 1881; ed. at Tunbridge schl. and Pembroke Coll., Camb.; 3rd cls. class. tripod; astt. res., N. Nigeria, 18th Aug., 1906; 3rd cls. res., 1st Jan., 1913; title changed to 2nd cls. dist. offr., 1st Jan., 1914; 1st cls. ditto, 22nd Mar., 1919; res. 16th Oct., 1921; ag. senr. res., 10th Jan., 1923.

WIGLEY, WILFRID MURRAY.—Ed. Derby schl.; held various clerical appttns. under govt., St. Kitts-Nevis, Feb., 1895, to Apr., 1898; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., Jan., 1901; practised at bar of Leeward Is. for some years; ag. admstr., St. Kitts, puisne judge, Leeward Is. and atty.-gen., on various occasions; crown atty., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1918.

WILCOCKS, CARL THEODORUS MULLER.—B. 1861; ed. Godbolt's Commi. Acad., Graaff Reinet; represented Fauresmith including Jagersfontein and Koffyfontein in first Union parl.; M.L.A. for Winburg (O.F.S.), 1915-24; mem., rly. and harbrs. bd., 1924; pub. debt, commr., 1925.

WILKIE, DAVID.—Ed. at Christ's Hosp., London; S. African campaign, 1900-1; pay and acctng. branch, S.A.C., 1902; clk. to lieut.-gov., O.R.C., 1902; ag. priv. sec. to lieut.-gov., O.R.C., 1906; ch. clk., gov.'s off., 1907; clk. of exec. coun., 1909; gov.-gen.'s off., Union of S. Africa, 1910; sec. to tender bd., 1911; ag. contr. of supplies, 1916; govt. buyer, 1920.

WILKINSON, ALAN FREDERICK LAWDER (Lieut., R.N.V.R.)—B. 1892; ed. Royal Naval Colls., Osborne and Dartmouth, and Trin. Coll., Cambridge; war service (Navy), 27th Aug., 1914, to 7th June, 1919; gunnery offr. from July, 1918; ast. dist. commr., G. Coast, 9th July, 1919; ag. dist. commr., 10th Sept. to 8th Nov., 1919.

WILKINSON, ERNEST EDWARD, M.B.E. (1922).—B. 1874; apptd., after compet. exam., olk., 2nd div., civ. ser., and assigned to the bd. of agriculture, May, 1894; transf. to C.O., June, 1896; minor staff offr., ch. clk.'s dept., 1902; clk. to finance and concessions comm., 1916; clk. for legal instruments, Sept., 1921; staff offr., 1st April, 1922; librarian, 26th Feb., 1923.

WILKINSON, H.S.—Chk., highcomsr.'s office, S. Africa, 1899; clk., polit. sec.'s office, Transval, 1900; acctnt. to sec., Transvaal adminstr., 1901; clk., col. sec.'s office, 1902; controller of stores, educn. dept., 1902; acctnt. health dept., 1904; sec., civ. serv. bd., 1906; distributor of stamps, treasy., 1906; distributor of stamps, dept. of finance, Union of S. Africa, 1910; prin. clk., treasy., 1916; ch. clk., treasy., 1925.

WILKINSON, REGINALD WARREN HALE K.C. (1924, Gold Coast Col.).—B. 1883; ed. France, Germany, Leamington Coll. and Balliol Coll., Oxford, B.A. (hons.), 1904; M.A., 1911; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1907; ast. dist. commr., Sierra Leone, 1909, admtd. to Sierra Leone bar, 1909; frequently acted as crown prosecutor, 1909-1911; ag. pol. mag., coroner and regir.-gen. in 1911 and 1913; J.P., Sierra Leone, 1911; ast. col. sec., 1912; acted as master of sup. ct. and as sol.-gen., S. Leone, 1913; senior crown counsel, Gold Coast, 1914; ag. solr.-gen., G. Coast, 1914; attached to legal adviser's dept., C.O., Apr.-May, 1915; solr.-gen., G. Coast, 28th Apr., 1915; ag. atty.-gen. and mem. exec. and legis. coun., Sept., 1915 to Mar., 1916; ag. puisne judge, G. Coast, Apl.-June, 1916; ag. atty.-gen., G. Coast, Nov., 1917 to Oct., 1918, Apr. to Oct., 1919, and from Oct., 1919 to Apr., 1920; puisne judge, G. Coast, 29th Mar., 1920; atty.-gen., 7th Apr., 1921; admtd. govt. of G. Coast, July-Dec., 1921.

WILKINSON, WALTER ALLERN.—B. 1872; ast. engrnr., P.W.D., F.M.S., 1902; ex. engrnr., grade III, 1906; ditto, grade II, 1908; ditto, grade I, 1914; lieut., R.E., 1915; capt., 1916; temp. major, 1916; served in France, 1916; state engrnr., Selangor, 1920.

WILLAN, HAROLD CURWEN, M.C., B.A., OXON.—B. 1896; ed. Kendal Grammar Schol. and Jesus Coll., Oxford; open exhib., Jesus Coll., Oxford; lieut., R.G.A.; M.C., 7th June, 1917; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1920; ag. 2nd ast. dist. offr., Tapah, May, 1921; ag. ast. dist. offr., Batang Padang, Jan., 1923; passed cadet, Jan., 1923; offr., cls. V., Oct., 1923; dist. offr., Jelebu, Dec., 1923; ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Aug., 1925; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Oct., 1925; offr. ast. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Nov., 1925.

WILLAN, REGINALD, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—Ed. Oakham Schol. and Guy's Hospital; med. offr. to Baro-Kano rly., Nigeria, 1909-1911; joined West African med. staff, 10th Jan., 1912.

WILDON, MARGARET ISABEL, M.B.E. (1925).—B. 1877; matron, Basutoiland leper asylum, 1913.

WILLETT, THOMAS GRAHAM.—B. 1883; ed. Merchant Taylors and St. John's Coll., Oxford (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1906; ast. astt. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Aug., 1908; pol. mag., Chilaw, Dec., 1909; addl. pol. mag., Galle, Matara, Tangalla, Hambantota and Balapitiya, July, 1910; pol. mag., Jaffna, Jan., 1911; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Jan., 1913; ag. dist. judge, Kegalla, Aug., 1913; ast. land settm. offr., and special offr. under waste land order, June, 1914; spec. commr. in connection with the rice, June, 1915; ast. land settm. offr., Sept., 1915; on military duty, 1918; ast. govt. agt., Kandy,
Feb., 1920; pol. mag., Point Pedro, May, 1923; asst. govt. agt., Kurunegala, Jan., 1923; ditto, Colombo, Dec., 1924.

WILLIAMS, A. D. J. B.—Med. offr., E.A.P., Aug., 1912; senr. med. offr., Kenya, Sept., 1923; ag. dep. dir., med. services, 1926.

WILLIAMS, CHARLES EDWARD, O.B.E. (1918), M.I.Mech.E.—B., 1873; ed. Llandovery Coll.; asst. wks. man., Vulcan loco. works, Lancs.; ch. inspr., N.Z. and W. Australian rly., 1898; entd. Crown Agent's office, 1900; asst. man., Robt. Stephenson's wks., Darlington, 1901; dep. ch. inspgr. engr., Crown Acts, 1904; staff capt. W.O., 1915; section dir., Miny. of Munitions, 1916; major, R.E., D.A.D., W.O., 1918; tech. head of engnr. inspection dept., C.A., 1919; visited Nigeria, 1920; Palestine and Cyprus, 1921; ch. inspgr. engr., 1922; mem. of coun., Inst. of Loco. Engrs.

WILLIAMS, D. L. GWINNE.—B. 1886; solr., sup. ct., Eng., 1914; served European War, 1915-18; ot. martial offr., 1918; staff capt. (legal), 1919; conveyancer and regiar. of titles, Uganda, 1923.

WILLIAMS, EDWARD BRIDGEWATER.—B. 1886; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1908; asst. dist. offr., Brusas, Mar., 1910; ag. asst. dist. offr., Pekan, July, 1911; ag. dist. offr., Dindinga, S.S., June, 1912; ag. asst. dist. offr., Larut, July, 1914; 2nd asst. dist. offr., Larut, Dec., 1914; asst. dist. offr., Kuantan, Aug., 1917; asst. dist. offr., Lower Perak, Sept., 1918; mag., Seremban, Jan., 1920; dist. offr., Tampin, Mar., 1920; dist. offr., Coast, Nov., 1920; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Pilah, Nov., 1921; collr., land rev., Seremban, Mar., 1922; ag. Br. res., Negri Sembilan, in addn., Aug., 1926; offr., ols. III, Nov., 1926; ag. collr., land rev., Seremban, Nov., 1925.

WILLIAMS, EDWARD LLOYD.—B. 1875; ed. at Brecon and Victoria Univ. (Univ. Coll., Liverpool); indentured for three years to the water engrnr. of Liverpool; student of the insttn. of civ. engrnr.; contractor's engrnr. on rly. construction, G.W.R.; res. engrnr. on waterworks construction, N. Wales county asylum; contractor's sub-agt. and engrnr. on rly. construction, G.W.R., served with 29th I.Y. (Denbighshire Hussars), South Africa, 1900-1; asst. engrnr. on rly. survey, Gold Coast and Ashanti, 1901-2; asst. sur. veyor of mines, G. Coast, 1902-3; ch. surveyor, 1904-5; contractor's agt., waterworks construction for Liverpool corporation, 1905-6; exec. engrnr., P.W.D., Northern Nigeria, 9th June, 1906; ag. dep. D.P.W., in 1908, 1910, 1911 and 1912.

WILLIAMS, ERIC TREGEAR.—B. 1890; ed. Blundell's schl. and Balliol Coll., Oxford; cadet, S. Stlitma. civ. ser., 28th Nov., 1913; attached to col. secs. office, 26th Dec., 1913; ag. supt., govt. printing office, 12th Mar., 1914; ag. dist. offr., Jasir, 1st Sept., 1915; dist. offr., Alor Gajah, 19th Oct., 1917; supernmy. offr., cls. IV, S. Stlitma., Nov., 1920; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec. "B," June, 1921; ag. 2nd asst. col. sec. "A," 5th Dec., 1921.

WILLIAMS, SIR RALPH CHAMPNEYS, K.C.M.G. (1907), C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1848; ed. at Rossall; explored parts of Patagonia and Terra-del Fuego, 1873-4; and Cent. Africas, 1883-4; head of civil intell. dept., Bechuana land expedit.,

E. Africa, 1914; appt. pres. of 2nd line of defence, 8th Aug., 1914; invalided out of the force, 13th Apr., 1915; and read. off. thanks of the govr. and comdr-in-chief and of the G.O.C., published in "Command Orders."

WILLIAMS, R. GREGSON.—Ed. at Rossall Sch., Caius Coll., Camb.; B.A. 3rd cls. hona., Science Tripos; Royal Sch. of Mines, A.S.R.M., last cls. diploma; post-graduate course, Mysore goldfields, India; asst. res., N. WILLINGDON, 1ST VISCOUNT (cr. 1924); 1st Baron of Ratton (cr. 1910); Freeman Freeman-Thomas, G.B.E. (1917); G.C.S.I. (1918); G.C.I.E. WILLIS, NORMAN EDWARD OMMANNEY.—B. 1872; ed. at Eton; entd. crown agent's office, 1st Jan., 1891; asst. cashier, 4th Jan., 1899; asst. acctnt., 1st July, 1902; acctnt. and dep. chief clk., 9th Jan., 1913; head of gen. dept. and ch. clk., 15th Nov., 1920.

WILLMOTT, ARTHUR CHARLES.—B. 1880; ed. Lancing Coll. and Aspatria Agric. Coll., Cumberland; asst. survr., Uganda Prot., Mar., 1907; dist. engnr., P.W.D., May, 1908; ag. asst., D.P.W., Apr.-Nov., 1913; engnr.-in-charge, Kampala Port Bell rwy. constr., Dec., 1913.

WILMOT, FREDERICK CHARLES, M.D., D.P.H., L.R.C.P.—Asst. health offr., dept. of pub. health, Union of S. Africa, 1913.

WILSON, BASIL MAYOR, M.B., Ch.B. (1901), D.P.H. (1911), M.D. (1911).—B. 1878; ed. Malvern Coll. Osmannieh; Egyptian bronze star; Order of Palm, French Govt.; gov. of Bermuda, 1907-1908; late G.O.C. Northern Army, India.

WOODEHOUSE, P. P. J., C.I.E. (1919).—B. 1877; ed. Eliz. Coll., Guernsey; first clk., regen.'s dept., Hong Kong, 1897-1900; passed in Chinese, 1899; census offr., 1900; asst. supt. of police, 1901; attached Punjab police, 1901-2; passed in Urdu, 1902; J.P., 1902; census offr., 1906; pol. mag., N.T. (Islands), Sept., 1906; passed in Punjabi, 1908; mem. of bd. of examiners, 1907; ag. dep. supt. of pol. and fire brig., 1907, 1908 to 1909, 1911 to 1912; census offr., 1911; dep. supt. of police and fire brigade, 1912; aide-de-camp to gov., 1918 to 1919; ag. capt. supt. of pol., on various occasions, 1918-25.

WODRMAN, GUY STANLEY.—B. 1886; ed. Rossall schl. and Jesus Coll., Camb. (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1909; office asst. to govt. agt., Sabaragamuwa, Oct., 1910; pol. mag., Matale, Feb., 1912; asst. commr. of excise attached to the office of the excise commr., Apr., 1913; asst. commr. of excise, Cent. Div., Jan., 1914; asst. govt. agt., Kandy, Apr., 1915; ag. asst. govt. agt., Matale, Aug., 1915; attached to chief censor's office, Sept., 1915; asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, Apr., 1916; ditto, Colombo, Oct., 1918; ditto, Nuwara Eliya, Dec., 1919; ditto, Kegalla, Dec., 1921; ditto, Matara, Mar., 1923; dep. collr., cust., Apr., 1925; dep. commr., excise, Nov., 1926.

WOLFE, E. D. C. Tonbridge schl. (1890-94); exhib. in mod. langa., Caius Coll., Camb. (1894); exhib. from Tonbridge schl. (1894); 3rd class mod. langa., tripos. (1896); 1st class Pt. I, and 2nd class Pt. II, Law Special (1897); B.A. (1897); M.A. (1925); cadet, F.M.S., 1898; sent to Canton to study Cantonese (1899); transf. to Hong Kong, 1901; passed cadet, Sept., 1901; sec., P.W.D. enquiry comm., 1901; reglar., land ct., 1901; ag. 2nd pol. mag., 1902; ag. asst. reglar.-gen., 1902; reglar., land ct., 1903; ag. pol. mag., N.T., and asst. supt. of pol., 1903-5; seconded to Transvaal govt. serv., 1905; ag. 2nd pol. mag., 1907; ag. inspr. of schla., 1907; ag. reglar.-gen., 1907; ag. asst. reglar.-gen., 1907; ag. inspr. of schla., 1907 to 1909; head of sanitary dept., 1909; postmnr.-gen., 1913; ag. col. treas., 1914-16; 1st pol. mag., 1917; ag. col. treas., and custodian of enemy property, 1917 and 1918; ag. capt. supt., pol., 1918; capt. supt. of pol., 1920; ag. col. sec., 1921; attended internat. pol. confce., New York, 1925.

WOLFE, HENRY, M.Sc. (Agric.) Cornell Univ. U.S.A.—B. 1887; tech. asst., dept. of agr., S. Africa, 1916; dep. dir., agr., Tanganyika Territory, 1920; ag. dir., agr., Feb. to Dec., 1921 and Mar. to Nov., 1924; E. Africa campaign 1916-17.

WOLFERTSTAN, LITTLETON EDWARD PIPER.—Ed. Eton and Clare Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1888; cadet, S.S., Oct., 1889; passed final exam in Malay, July, 1891; ag. priv. sec. to Sir C. Smith Jan. to Apr., 1890; ag. dist. offr., Bukit Mertajam, Feb. to Mar., and June to Nov., 1892; ag. dist. offr., S.W. dist., Penang, Mar., 1893; 3rd mag., Penang, Apr., 1893; ag. dist. offr., prov.
Wellesley, June, 1897; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore Aug., 1897; sheriff and dep. registr., sup. ct., Singapore, 1898, but still ag. 2nd mag., Singapore; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, Feb., 1900; ag. collr. ld. rev., Penang, May, 1900; ag. sec. to H. Cr. for Fed. Malay States, May, 1901; ag. sen. dist. offr. Prov. Wellesley, May, 1902; collector of land rev. and regis. of deeds, Penang, Aug., 1902; offl. assignee, S.S., Sept., 1903; sen. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Feb., 1907; ag. 1st mag., Penang, Apr., 1907; ag. inspr. of prisons, S.S., Apr., 1909; ag. dist. judge and 1st mag., Singapore, Oct., 1909; ag. dist. judge (civil), Singapore, Feb., 1910; ag. dist. judge and 1st mag., Singapore, Apr., 1910; res., Malacca, July, 1910, and Dec., 1915; ag. British adviser, Kedah, June, 1914 to Apr., 1915; offr., cls. Ia., Jan., 1919; title of appt. altered to res. coun., Malacca, mem. of exec. coun. and offl. mem. of leg. coun., Jan., 1921.

WOLFF, ERNEST CHARLIS HOLFORD.—F.M.S. civ. ser.; b. 1875; ed. at Merchiston and Trin. Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1897; cadet, Pahang, F.M.S., Nov., 1897; passed final exam. in Malay, May, 1899; ag. treas., supt. of posts and tels., and collr. of stamp duties, Pahang, Jan., 1898; ag. asst. dist. offr., Pekan, May, 1899; ag. sec. to res., Negri Sembilan, May, 1901; sec. to ditto, Oct., 1901; ag. asst. sec. to res.-gen., F.M.S., May, 1906; dist. offr., Kuantan, Sept., 1909, but still ag. asst. sec. to res.-gen.; ag. chmn. and sec., sanitary bd., Kinta South, Perak, Jan., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Upper Perak, Apr., 1911; officiating dist. offr., Larut, Jan., 1912; officiating supt. of convict estabt. and inspr. of prisons, F.M.S., Feb., 1915; ag. asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., S. Stltmts., Apr., 1915, to Sept., 1919; offr., cls. Ib., Jan., 1919; prin. asst. col. sec., Jan., 1920; ag. col. sec., S. Stltmts., 12th to 27th Feb., 1921; ag. dir., educon., S. Stltmts. and F.M.S., June, 1921; dir. educon., S. Stltmts. and F.M.S., Dec., 1921; ag. Br. adviser, Kedah, Dec., 1923; Br. res., Negri Sembilan, July, 1924.

WOLFE, PHINAK ERNEST.—B. 1885; ed. Glasgow Academy; clk., land dept., E.A.P., 1909; ag. office supt., 1917; land asst., 1919; regis. of titles, documents and coast land titles, 1920; liquidator of enemy property, July-Nov., 1921.

WOLSELEY-BOURNE, CAPT. JAMES FREDERICK, M.C.—B. 1878; 2nd lieut. Royal Berks. Regt.; lieut. S. African Constab.; served in S. African war, 1899-1902 (Queen's and King's medals); capt., K.A.R.; served in E. Africa, 1914-1918 ("1914-15" Star, War and Victory medals); commanded a column in operations against Aulihan (Somali) tribe, Jubaland, 1917-18 (M.C., African Gen. Serv. medal); supt. of police, Kenya, 1919; ag. asst. commsr., pol., 1925.

WOOD, A. E.—Ed. at Liverpool Coll.; scholar of Univ. Coll., Oxford, 1903; 1st mods.; 2nd lit. hum.; cadet, Hong Kong, 1907; offr. for exam. of male assisted emigrants, 1908; ag. asst. registr.-gen., 1908 to 1909; passed cadet, 1st Apr., 1910; ag. asst. registr.-gen., Apr.-May, 1910; ag. asst. dist. offr., N.T., 1910 to 1911; 2nd asst. registr.-gen., 1911; ag. asst. dist. offr., South dist., New Territories, 1911 to 1912; passed in Hakka, 14th June, 1912; title of asst. registr.-gen. altered to 2nd asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, 1913; ag. 1st asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, 1913; ag. chief asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, 1914; ag. dist. offr., 1915; ag. chief asst. to S.C.A., 1916, and 1918 to 1919; passed in Pekingese, June, 1916; sent to Japan to study Japanese, 1916; passed in Japanese, May, 1918; ag. dist. offr., Taipo, 1919 to 1920; ag. ch. asst. to sec. for Chinese affrs., 1921; ag. dist. offr., Taipo in addn., 1922; ag. sec. for Chinese affrs., 1923 and 1924; ag. dir., educon., Dec., 1925.

WOOD, BERNARD READER.—B. 1890; ed. Tonbridge Schl., Sid. Suss. Coll., Camb.; M.A., dipl. in forestry; asst. conservator, Indian forest serv., 1914; dep. conservator, 1918; conservator, of forests, Br. Guiana, 1925.

WOOD, FRANCIS ERNEST, M.B., B.C. (Cantab.), 1902, B.A. (nat. sci. tripos) 1898—B. 1877; ed. Downing Coll., Cambridge and St. Bartholomew Hosp., London; London Schl. Trop. Med., 1905; med. offr., Malay States Guides, 1905-20; on active serv. with Aden Field Force, 1915-19; ment. in despa., Apr., 1919; major (local), 1920; sen. med. offr., Perak, 1921; ag. prin. med. offr., F.M.S., Apr., 1922-Mar., 1923.

WOOD, JOHN R.—Ed. City of London schl. and Camb.; foundation scholar of Jesus Coll., 1896; 1st cl. class. tripos, 1899; B.A., 1899; M.A., 1913; called to the bar, 1919; cadet, Hong Kong, 1899; registr. of land ct., 1900; ag. pol. mag. in New Territories, 1902; J.P., 1902; passed cadet, 1902; mem. land ct., 1904-3; asst. land offr. in N. T., Jan., 1905; ag. asst. reg-gen., 1905; mem. of squatters' bd., 1906; ag. 2nd pol. mag., 1908; dep. regis. and appraiser, sup. ct., 1908; 2nd pol. mag., 1909; ag. dir. of educn., 1911 to 1912; ag. 1st pol. mag., on several occasions; 1st pol. mag., 1920; ag. puisne judge, 1920-22 and in 1925; chmn., Sui An piracy coun., 1922; puisne judge, 1926.

WOOD, LESLIE WILLIAM.—B. 1890; ed. Merchant Taylors' schl. and Queens' coll., Camb.; 1st cl. math. tripos, pt. 1; 2nd cl. math. tripos, pt. 2; B.A., 1912; asst. dist. commsr., Gold Coast, 18th Aug., 1914; asst. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1921; ag. elk. of couns., Feb., 1922.

WOOD, CAPT. REGINALD CECIL MERVYN.—B. 1889; E. African Expedy. Force, 1915-17; seconded, K.A.R., 1918; K.A.R. staff, 1919; adjt., 3rd K.A.R., 1919-22; coy. commdr., 1923; asst. treas., Kenya, 1923.

WOOD, WILLIAM HAROLD.—B. 1896; ed. Abingdon schl.; served with Royal Berkshire Regt., 1915-20; France, 1916-19; Egypt, 1919-20; lieut., July, 1917; ag. capt., Apr., 1918; ment. in despa., 1918; cadet, F.M.S., 15th Apr., 1921; attd., dist. office, Port Dickson, Oct., 1921; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuala Selangor, May, 1923; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuantan, Mar., 1924; ag. supt., lands, Kelantan, Apr., 1925.

WOODFORD, HON. W. W.—Elected M.H.A., Harbor Main, Newfoundland, 1889; chrmn., bd. of works, 1897; min. of public works, 1898, 1909, and 1918; M.E.C., 1918.

WOODHOUSE, GEORGE WILLIAM.—B. 1867; ed. St. John's Coll., Camb.; LL.M., Camb.; math. trip.; M.A. of the Middle Temple; Campbell-Foster prizeman, 1910; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1916; cadet, local div., Ceylon civ. ser., Sept., 1892; asst. collr. of cust., Jaffna, Dec., 1892; Trincomalee, Dec., 1895; dist. judge, Tangalla, Oct., 1897, and in Mar., 1898; addtl. dist. judge, etc., Matara, Oct., 1898; addtl. pol. mag., Matara, Mar., 1899; pol. mag., Galle, Dec., 1901; dist. judge, Negombo, Feb., 1905; Batticaloa, Dec., 1905; dist. judge, Matara, June, 1912; dist. judge, Kurunegala, May, 1913; addtl. dist. judge and addtl. pol. mag., Kandy, May, 1915; dist. judge, Kurunegala, Sept., 1916;
ditto, Jaffna, Apr., 1920; ag. addnl. dist. judge, Colombo, Jan., 1922; dist. judge, Jaffna, Mar., 1922.

WOODHOUSE, JOHN LESLIE.—B. 1892; ed. Merchant Taylors Sch.; asst. transport offr., with rank of lieut., Uganda Transport Corps, 27th Nov., 1914; ment. in desps. for service in German E. Africa, 22nd Nov., 1916; asst. dist. commr., Uganda, 30th Dec., 1916; 2nd grade adminstr. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 17th June, 1920.

WOODS, PERCY SINCLAIR COMYN.—B. 1879; ed. St. Michael's Sch., Lyme Regis, and Durham Univ.; clk., col. audit branch, exchequer and audit dept., Somerset House, 1st Jan., 1903; asst. auditor, Lagos and S. Nigeria, 29th Apr., 1905; dep. ch. acctnt., G. Coast rly., 30th Jan., 1909; ag. ch. acctnt., 21st Mar. to 26th Sept., 1909; promoted rly. acctnt. on abolition of office of ch. acctnt., 31st Jan., 1910; col. treas., Feb., 1922.

WOODS, WILFRED WENTWORTH, C.M.G. (1928)—B. 1878; B.A. Oxon.; 2nd cls. final hon. schl., mod. hist., 1901; clk., col. audit branch, E. and A. dept., 2nd Sept., 1901; asst. auditor, G. Coast, 22nd Feb., 1902; local auditor, N. Nigeria, 30th Oct., 1904; asst. col. auditor, Ceylon, 8th Feb., 1908; ag. col. auditor on several occasions; col. auditor, Aug., 1915; temp. employed at the War Office, Dec., 1917 to 1919; ag. col. treas., May to Nov., 1920; ag. P.M.G., Nov., 1920 to Apr., 1921; col. treas., Feb., 1922; ag. col. sec., 30th Sept. to 17th Oct., 1926.

WOOLLEY, CHARLES CAMPBELL.—B. 1893; on milly. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1921; attd., Kandy Cash, June, 1921; ag. office asst. to gov't.; agt. N.C. Prov., Sept., 1922; 4th astt. col. sec., Feb., 1924; 3rd astt. col. sec., Mar., 1925; temp. attd. C.O., 1925 to June, 1926; addnl. astt. col. sec., Sept., 1926; 3rd astt. col. sec., Oct., 1926.

WOOLLEY, HOWARD MARK.—B. 1879; apptd., after open compet. exam., to G.P.O., London, and served in different depts.; astt. postmtr.-gen., N. Nigeria, 22nd Apr., 1908; deputy P.M.G., 1st Apr., 1908; P.M.G., 31st Oct., 1910.

WORKMAN, CHARLES RUFUS MARSHALL.—B. 1874; ed. Christ Ch., Oxford, M.A.; called to bar, Inner Temple; pol. offr., Ocean Is., 1909; dep. commr., Western Pacific, 1911; admstr., Nauru, 1914; ag. res. commr., Gilbert and Ellice Is., May, 1916 to Feb., 1917; ag. res. commr., Solomon Is., June, 1917; asst. commr., Apr., 1919; judl. commr., Feb., 1920; col. sec., Gambia, Sept., 1921; ag. gov. on various occasions, 1921-25.

WORLEY, NEWNHAM ARTHUR.—B. 1892; ed. Emmanuel Coll., Cambridge, B.A., 1913; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1914; astt. contr. of lab., Kampar, July, 1917; astt. dist. offr., Ipoh, May, 1920; astt. prot. of Chinese, Negri Sembilan and ag. dep. contr. of lab., Seremban, Aug., 1920; astt. prot. of Chinese, Perak, Dec., 1921; astt. dir. of educn. (Chinese), F.M.S., June, 1922; ag. astt. dir., educn. (Chinese), S.S. and F.M.S., Jan., 1924.

WORLDENGE, JOHN LEONARD.—B. 1896; ed. St. Paul's Sch.; active service in France, Sept., 1914 to Sept., 1918; ment. in desps.; Ireland, 1919; astt. audr., Kenya, Apr., 1920; astt. audr. in charge, Zanzibar, May 1920 to Feb., 1921; ag. senr. astt. audr., Kenya, Mar., 1923; senr. astt. audr., Nov., 1925.

WORSLEY, RALPH MARCUS MEABURN, B.A. Oxon.—B. 1887; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., 12th Nov., 1910; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Dec., 1910; attached to col. sec.'s office, Aug., 1911; extra office asst. to gov't. agt., W. Prov., Oct., 1911; astt. land settm't offr., Jan., 1912; office astt. to gov't. agt., Central Prov., July, 1914; astt. censor, Dec., 1914; on military duty, Feb., 1915; ag. astt. gov't. agt., Mullaitivu, Nov., 1917; astt. gov't. agt., Trincomalee, Sept., 1921; ag. gov't. agt., Prov. of Uva, Aug. to Oct., 1922; astt. stimt. offr., Jan., 1924; astt. gov't. agt., Hambantota, May, 1924.

WORTHINGTON, ARTHUR FURLEY.—B. 1874; ed. at Tonbridge and Sidney Sussex Coll., Camb.; B.A., 1896; M.A., 1910; cadet, Perak, Nov., 1897; passed cadet, Feb., 1900; ag. astt. dist. offr., Kuala Lipis, June, 1900; astt. dist. offr., Kuala Pilah, Feb., 1902; offr., cls. VI., Jan., 1903; ag. ch. astt. dist. offr., Kinta, June, 1905; offr., cls. V., Sept., 1904; offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1908; offr. dist. offr., Kuantan, Aug., 1910; offr., cls. III., Jan., 1912; dist. offr., Kuala Lipis, July, 1917, Lower Perak, Feb., 1919; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; ag. Br. adviser, Kelantan, Mar., 1920; offr. dist. offr., Ulu Selangor, Jan. to June, 1921; Br. adviser, Kelantan, Sept., 1922; ag. dist. offr., Larut, Mar.-Aug., 1922; appt. of Br. adviser, Kelantan raised to "staff," July, 1924; on sp. duty, England, Apr., 1924; Br. adviser, Kelantan, May, 1925; ag. Br. res., Pahang, Dec., 1925; Br. res., Pahang, Feb., 1926.

WORTLEY, EDWARD JOCELYN, O.B.E. (1926), M.B.E.—B. 1884; ed. Jamaica Coll.; course in agric. and agric. chem. at Jamaica, govt. lab. and sp. course at the Ontario agric. coll.; fellow of the chem. socy., 1906; jnr. astt. chem., Jamaica, 1902; astt. chem., 1905; lect. in agric. sci., 1906; headmstr., govt. farm schl. and stock farm, 1909; comnrs. for Jamaica, Canadian Nat. Exhibn., Sept., 1910, and Sept., 1912; dir. of agr., Bermuda, 1913-20; food comnrs., 1917; hon. sec., internat. comtes. on potato industry, 1919; visited Canary Is. on behalf of Bermuda govt., 1920; dir. of agr., Nyassaland, Dec., 1920; author of "Companion to Blackie's Tropical Readers," "Poultry Diseases," and "Foods and Food Products of Jamaica."

WRATISLAW, JOHN CYRIL.—B. 1894; ed. Oundle Schl.; astt. dist. commr., Sierra Leone, 14th Jan., 1924.

WRIGHT, ANDREW BARKWORTH, M.A., M.C. (1917), Bar (1918).—B. 1895; ed. Haileybury and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; served in European War with Suffolk Regt., 1914-19; major, 1918; astt. sec., ch. sec's. office, Cyprus, 3rd June, 1922; astt. priv. sec. to O.A.G., June to Oct., 1923; astt. priv. sec. to high commr., Apr. to June and Sept. to Oct., 1924; priv. sec. and A.D.C. to O.A.G., June to Sept., 1924; ag. ch. astt. sec., reg'r. of co-op. societies and reg'r. of co-op. credit societies, Apr. to Oct. 1924; passed exam. in mod. Greek, Aug., 1924; ditto, Turkish, Apr., 1925.

WRIGHT, ARTHUR EDGAR.—B. 1880; Fellow of the Surveyors' Institution; ed. at Tiffin's Endowed Schl., Kingston-on-Thames; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, 5th May, 1903; exec. engrnr., 1911; ag. assessor in addition, 1915; exec. engrnr., 1st grade, 1917; seconded to Weihaieu on special serv., 1918 and 1920; astt. astt. D.P.W., 1923.

WRIGHT, CHARLES HAROLD.—M.A., F.I.C. F.C.S.; B. 1880; scholar, Sidney Sussex Coll., Cambridge; B.A. (Nat. Sc. Tripos), 1902; M.A., 1916; astt. analyst and science master, Trinidad, Apr., 1908; ag. govt. analyst and prof. of chemistry
Trinidad, on two occasions; agric. chemist, Fiji, Mar., 1914; ag. dist. commr., Kadavu, July-Aug., 1918; govt. chem., Fiji, Jan., 1920; senr. agr. chem., Nigeria, June, 1923.

WRIGHT, H. PELLEW.—Served in S. Africa war in I.Y. and S.A.C., 1899-1902 (Queen's medal and 3 clasps, King's medal and 2 clasps); staff offr. to O.C., Riet River div., O.R.C.; dist. commr., Edenburg and other districts, O.R.C., 1903-1906; asst. dist. commr., Uganda Prot., 15th Oct., 1908; dist. commr., June, 1914; recd. Royal Humane Society's medal for saving life.

WRIGHT, HERBERT ARTHUR.—B. 1882; instr., govt. technical schl., Accra, G. Coast, 10th Apr., 1909; principal, ditto, 28th Sept., 1911; attached to Togoland field force, 16th Aug. to 8th Sept., 1914; in joint charge of detention camp for German prisoners of war, 8th Dec., 1914 to 13th Jan., 1915; asst. censor, 2nd Oct., 1914 to 2nd Feb., 1915, and 2nd Oct., 1915 to 26th Feb., 1916; prov. inspr. of schls., 25th July, 1917; ag. senr. inspr. of schls., 29th July to 19th Sept., 1917; asst. dir., educn., 1st Apr., 1926.

WRIGHT, HON. ROBERT ALEXANDER.—Mem., N.Z. parlmt., 1908-11 and since 1914; min. of educn., 1926.

WRIGHT, VICTOR WILLIAM, A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1891; served with R. Naval Divn. in Gallipoli and France; wounded, 1914-16; lieut., R.E. and gen. staff, Macedonia, Caucasus, Trans-Caspia, Constantinople, 1916-20; mast., tech. schl., educn. dept., Gold Coast, 1921.

WRIGHT, WM.—B. 1855; clk. to pub. trustee, S. Aust., 1885; ch. clk. to pub. trustee, and ch. clk., succession duties dept., 1891; pub. trustee and curator of convicts' estates, 1903.

WRIGHT-NOOTH, CAPT. RODNEY GEORGE, M.C. (1916), A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1884; ed. St. Paul's Schl., stud., engnr. faculty, King's Coll., London, 1904-08; 2nd lieut., R.E., 1909; engnr. on survey and constrn. of Magadi rly. and water wks., 1911-14; R.E., 1914-22; served, Kenya, German E. Africa and Jubaland; severely wounded, twice ment. in desps., M.C.; div. offr., R.E. Londonderry and Enniskillen Divs., Ireland, Apr., 1920 to Apr., 1922; capt., Reg. Army, R. of O., 1922; supt. of pub. wks., Antigua, 4th Aug., 1922; mem., leg. coun., Antigua, 1922; asst., D.W.P., B. Guiana, 1926.

WROUGHTON, JOHN HENRY.—B. 1877; med. offr., Basutoland, 1908.

WUPPERMAN, RUDOLF CARL, M.B., Ch.B., Edin.—B. 1883; entered med. serv., Trinidad, 18th Oct., 1909; asst. res. surg., colonial hosp., Port of Spain, 27th Oct., 1914; res. surg., col. hosp., 8th May, 1923.

WYATT, ALEXANDER HENRY LOUIS.—Ed. Wellington; served in Impl. Yeomanry, S. African War, 1900-01; Queen's Med., 4 clasps; W.O., 1901-04; asst. res., Nyasaland, 1904-14; seconded for serv. with 1st K.A.R., 1914-17; ment. in desps. and awarded M.C.; served in Nyasaland rising, 1915; A.G.S.M. and clasp; dist. polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1917; sen. commr., Nov., 1922; prov. commr., Mar., 1926.

WYATT, ROBT.—B. 1870; Lond. Metro. pol., 1891 to 1896; B. Hond. pol., June, 1895; asst. supt., Feb., 1902; ag. supt., May, 1902, to May, 1903; ag. dist. commr., Orange Walk, July to Aug., 1903; ag. dist. commr., Coroal, 26th Apr. to 11th July, 1906; ditto, Caya, Feb., 1906; ag. supt. pol., 14th July, 1906; J.P. for Colony; Hythe extra certif., 1899; supt. of pol., 1st Apr., 1906; certif. of proficiency for field offrs. with spec. distinction, schl. of instr., Chelsea barracks, 1907; certif. for management of English convict and local prisons, 1907; attached to London fire brigade for training, 1907.

WYNNE-JONES, EDWARD IRVINE.—B. 1896; ed. Oxford and Univ. of Wales; cadet, Hong Kong, July, 1920; ag. dist. offr., South, June, 1922; addl. col. secretariat, Nov., 1922; passed final exam., Feb., 1923; dist. offr., North, May, 1923.

YATES, GEO. W.—B. 1872; ed. London pub. and high schls.; ent. civ. serv. of Ont. as priv. sec. to various mins. from Feb., 1899 to Oct., 1911; accompanied Hon. F. Cochrane, Ont. min. of lands, forests and mines, to Ottawa on latter accepting portfolio of min. of rlys. and canals in Borden govt.; cont. priv. sec., min. of rlys. and canals until formation of union govt., 1917, when became ch. priv. sec. to Sir Robt. Borden; asst. dep. min. of rlys. and canals, 1920.

YATES, JOSEPH MERVYN ST. JOHN, B.A.—B. 1878; ed. Winchester Coll. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; called to the bar, Inner Temple, May, 1903; northern circuit, 1903-15; H.M. Forces, 1915-19; reglar-gen. Bahamas, Feb., 1920; ag. stip. magis., Mar., 1920; ag. atty.-gen., Nov., 1920; ag. ch. just., Feb.-Mar., 1921; ag. stip. and circuit mag., Mar., 1921 to Sept., 1922; seconded for serv. as ag. asst. to atty.-gen., Jamaica, Sept., 1922; res. mag., Jamaica, 1923; ag. atty.-gen., Apr., 1923 to Jan., 1924; ag. judge, Kingston ct., Nov., 1924 to Oct., 1925; ag. puisne judge, Oct., 1925; circuit judge, Ashanti and N. Territories, Gold Coast, 1926.

YOUILL, JOSEPH.—Seconded from Impl. serv. to B. E. Africa and Uganda Prot., as 1st grade dist. survr., 1st Jan., 1913 to 17th Dec., 1915; seconded to G. Coast, 31st May, 1916; offr.-in-charge, post and telegraph dept., Togoland, 22nd May, 1918 to 23rd Jan., 1919, and from 12th Aug., 1919.

YOUNG, ALFRED ERNEST, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.), L.D.S. (Eng.).—B. 1891; med. offr., Basutoland, 1924.
